face.name: 银叶草药膏
face.text: 使你的武器获得“在你的英雄攻击后，抽一张牌。”
face.flavorText: 卡扎库斯下药的方式越来越直接了。

face.name: Silverleaf Poison
face.text: Give your weapon "After your hero attacks, draw a card."
face.flavorText: Kazakus has taken to a more direct approach in recent times.

face.name: 麻痹药膏
face.text: 使你的武器获得+1攻击力和“你的英雄在攻击时免疫。”
face.flavorText: 其实只要锤子就够了。

face.name: Paralytic Poison
face.text: Give your weapon +1 Attack and "Your hero is Immune while attacking."
face.flavorText: The hammer is overkill.

face.name: 致命药膏
face.text: 使你的武器获得+2攻击力。
face.flavorText: 潜行者们都小心翼翼地保守着制毒的秘密，唯恐法师们把毒药用在他们的法术之中。毒性箭？剧毒之雨？毒元素？听上去就很可怕。

face.name: Deadly Poison
face.text: Give your weapon +2 Attack.
face.flavorText: Rogues guard the secrets to poison-making carefully, lest magi start incorporating poison into their spells. Poisonbolt? Rain of Poison? Poison Elemental? Nobody wants that.

face.name: 吸血药膏
face.text: 在本回合中，你的武器获得 吸血。
face.flavorText: 本品为纯天然制剂，未添加任何有毒有害物质。

face.name: Leeching Poison
face.text: Give your weapon Lifesteal this turn.
face.flavorText: No actual leeches were harmed in the creation of this card.

face.name: 刀瓣齐射
face.text: 将两张可造成2点伤害的“刀瓣”置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 经常不洗澡的人，会有头皮屑。经常不洗澡的花…

face.name: Razorpetal Volley
face.text: Add two Razorpetals to your hand that deal 2 damage.
face.flavorText: The result of a fundamental misunderstanding of the phrase "flower power".

face.name: 拟态豆荚
face.text: 抽一张牌，然后将一张它的复制置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 妈妈常说，吃啥补啥！

face.name: Mimic Pod
face.text: Draw a card, then add a copy of it to your hand.
face.flavorText: Jinx!

face.name: 浸毒武器
face.text: 使你的武器获得剧毒。
face.flavorText: 毒液取自安戈洛的当地植物，威力惊人。

face.name: Envenom Weapon
face.text: Give your weapon Poisonous.
face.flavorText: Like Deadly Poison, but deadlier.

face.name: 孢子致幻
face.text: 发现一张你对手职业的卡牌。
face.flavorText: 是好的那种幻觉。

face.name: Spore Hallucination
face.text: Discover a card from your opponent's class.
face.flavorText: It's the good kind of hallucination.

face.name: 氮素药膏
face.text: 使一个随从获得+2攻击力。腐蚀：并使你的武器获得+2攻击力。
face.flavorText: 倒进油箱里的冰牛奶并不能提供氮气加速，但用来做胜利纪念甜点却是一流。

face.name: Nitroboost Poison
face.text: Give a minion +2 Attack. Corrupt: And your weapon.
face.flavorText: Pouring iced milk into your vehicle's fuel tank does NOT provide a Nitro boost, but it does go great with your victory cookies.

face.name: 刀瓣
face.text: 造成 2点伤害。

face.name: Razorpetal
face.text: Deal 2 damage.

face.name: 氮素药膏
face.text: 已腐蚀 使一个随从和你的武器获得+2攻击力。

face.name: Nitroboost Poison
face.text: Corrupted Give a minion and your weapon +2 Attack.

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

policies.weapons: grant to the current physical equipped weapon, retain existing attack-completion and residence semantics
policies.temporary_lifesteal: expires at the current global turn end by existing keyword expiry
policies.silverleaf: each real weapon grant draws once after its actual hero attack, including its final durability use
policies.mimic_pod: one original actual physical draw; copy_self reuses captured current-copy material including burn/draw-cast policy
policies.hallucination: capture actual opponent hero_class; original standard constructed.cards pool and exact class query; never infer another class
policies.nitro: base minion +2 Attack; real Corrupt face uses the same original physical upgrade and adds current weapon +2 when present

uncertainties: Mimic Pod retains the established physical draw-copy capture timing; exact live-server draw-trigger/transform boundaries remain uncalibrated.
Weapon grants retain existing physical carrier, replacement, final-wear and attack-stage local contracts.
Full Warrior/ Shaman views are not opened by the dual-class YOP_015 addition; all original nonempty unreviewed scopes still reject.
Past-set definition, uniform local weights and version/CN differences retain original explicit local policies.
